cs2Loadouts.label: Project 1
cs2Loadouts.title: Streamer CS2 loadouts
cs2Loadouts.subtitle: The first StreamersItems collection — iconic skins and knives from streamers you follow. Tap a slot to mark it collected.

p1BusterGoldAk.description: A full-gold AK from Buster’s on-stream flex loadout — the kind of skin chat spams «inspect» for.
p1BusterGoldAk.funFact: Gold Arabesque drops from Operation Riptide cases — one of the few AK finishes that looks like jewelry in inspect.

p1DonkKnife.description: donk’s butterfly doppler is basically a highlight reel accessory: flashy, loud, and always center stage.
p1DonkKnife.funFact: Butterfly knives have a unique flip animation — CS2 players call it free morale before the first duel.

p1S1mpleAwp.description: The Dragon Lore AWP linked with s1mple’s legacy — a trophy-skin energy even as a showcase piece.
p1S1mpleAwp.funFact: Dragon Lore is a Cobblestone collection skin; real souvenir versions can sell for more than a compact car.

p1ShroudM4.description: Shroud’s clean Printstream M4 fits his «headshot first, chat second» aesthetic on custom servers.
p1ShroudM4.funFact: Printstream uses a monochrome sci-fi print that stays readable in both bright and dark maps.

p1OverdriveGloves.description: Neon Vice gloves from m0NESY’s CS2 wardrobe — gloves that steal the killfeed spotlight.
p1OverdriveGloves.funFact: Sport Gloves changed how players match skins: full loadouts are often built around glove color first.

p1StarterUsp.description: Buster’s starter USP — not the flashiest gun, but every inventory legend begins with pistol rounds.
p1StarterUsp.funFact: Ticket to Hell is a community favorite for budget blue loadouts — cheap entry, big personality.

tarkovLoot.label: Project 2
tarkovLoot.title: Streamer Tarkov loot
tarkovLoot.subtitle: Streamer items for Escape from Tarkov — Collector-style loot with category filters. Tap a slot to mark it collected.

p2NutSackBalaclava.description: TheBurntPeanut’s Nut Sack balaclava — meme-tier headwear from the streamer item pool.
p2NutSackBalaclava.funFact: Added in late 2025; spawns on Scavs like other streamer cosmetics.

p2DomontovichUshanka.description: Domontovich ushanka — cold-raid cosplay with a creator tag.
p2DomontovichUshanka.funFact: Part of the expanding streamer item roster tied to Russian creators.

p2PestilyMask.description: Pestily plague mask — the mask chat recognizes before the voice line.
p2PestilyMask.funFact: Classic streamer item since early Tarkov wipes.

p2ShroudHalfMask.description: Shroud half-mask — minimal face cover, maximum streamer recognition.
p2ShroudHalfMask.funFact: Drops from Scavs; a staple flex slot.

p2JohnbGlasses.description: JohnB Liquid DNB glasses — Dunduk’s signature shades as in-game loot.
p2JohnbGlasses.funFact: Often called «Dunduk glasses» in the community.

p2ViibiinSneaker.description: Viibiin sneaker — footwear loot that feels like a highlight reel drop.
p2ViibiinSneaker.funFact: Safes and jacket raids love hiding these.

p2NoiceguyPressPass.description: Press pass issued for NoiceGuy — Labs energy in item form.
p2NoiceguyPressPass.funFact: Sports bags and streamer loot tables.

p2RavenFigurine.description: Raven figurine — trophy from Markstrom’s tournament win.

p2LootLordPlushie.description: Loot Lord plushie — AquaFPS / Lupo mascot in plush form.
p2LootLordPlushie.funFact: Sports bags; chat always calls it Lupo.

p2MastichinFigurine.description: Mastichin figurine — mustache memes turned into barter loot.
p2MastichinFigurine.funFact: Newer figurine line from recent wipes.

p2SheefggPiggyBank.description: SheefGG piggy bank — mini stash for roubles with streamer branding.
p2SheefggPiggyBank.funFact: Marked rooms and late-wipe economy flex.

p2MutkevichFigurine.description: Politician Mutkevich figurine — satire you can hand in or flex.
p2MutkevichFigurine.funFact: Part of the trader figurine set.

p2RyzhyFigurine.description: Ryzhy figurine — red-scav personality as a shelf piece.

p2DuckFigurine.description: Duck figurine — the mandarin-plush meme the community calls «tangerine duck».
p2DuckFigurine.funFact: Event reward turned collectible barter item.

p2Kc130Model.description: LM KC-130 model aircraft — AirwingMarine’s aviation nod.
p2Kc130Model.funFact: Labs manager office / arsenal spawns on some wipes.

p2YmxWater.description: Bottle of YMXC water — creator-branded hydration loot.
p2YmxWater.funFact: Food spawns and ration crates on Customs and beyond.

p2GigabeefMeat.description: Can of GigaBeef meat — tushonka energy with streamer label.
p2GigabeefMeat.funFact: Ration crates; wipe 1.1 streamer food trio.

p2FrenchBaguette.description: French bakery baguette — Cocaoo_’s long bread for short raids.
p2FrenchBaguette.funFact: Food spawns; part of the 2026 food streamer set.

p2HolodilnickBag.description: Mr. Holodilnick thermal bag — lunchbox loot with creator branding.
p2HolodilnickBag.funFact: Thermal bag slot; keeps the meme cold.

p2InseqWrench.description: Inseq gas pipe wrench — adjustable wrench with streamer paint.
p2InseqWrench.funFact: Technical crates; bright red tool flex.

p2Fireklean.description: #FireKlean gun lube — Klean’s iconic gold tube.
p2Fireklean.funFact: Labs tech / streamer item classic since 2018.

p2DeadlyslobBeardOil.description: Deadlyslob’s beard oil — OG streamer item from early wipes.
p2DeadlyslobBeardOil.funFact: Shoreline and interchange counters; collector veteran bait.

p2LvndmarkRatPoison.description: LVNDMARK’s rat poison — meme consumable with serious flea price.

p2MazoniDumbbell.description: Mazoni golden dumbbell — gym bro loot for hideout flex.
p2MazoniDumbbell.funFact: Safes; cultist circle FIR tricks on some wipes.

p2TigzresqSplint.description: Tigzresq splint — medical streamer item for leg meta jokes.

p2MissamForkliftKey.description: Missam forklift key — DanExert / Missam forklift meme key.
p2MissamForkliftKey.funFact: Jacket pockets; tiny key, big chat reaction.

p2VeritasGuitarPick.description: Veritas guitar pick — tiny loot, huge streamer recognition.

p2TamatthiKunai.description: Tamatthi kunai knife replica — melee memento, not meta, all style.

p2DundukFloppy.description: Dunduk floppy disk — retro storage for Tarkov.Help vibes.

p2DesmondpilakCd.description: DesmondPilak CD — album loot from the Tarkov DJ.

p2CyborgKillerVhs.description: Cassette with «Cyborg Killer» — Проходимец VHS collectable.

p2SilverBadge.funFact: Older collector piece; still a status slot.

p2BatteredAntiqueBook.description: Battered antique book — DobbyKillStreak’s dusty tome.
p2BatteredAntiqueBook.funFact: Safe loot; quest hand-in history on some accounts.

inventory.title: Cyber inventory
inventory.subtitle: Interactive streamer item slots — rarity glow, tilt, glitch on vault items. Tap a slot to mark it collected.
inventory.hint: Neon live dot = streamer online. Legendary and secret items glitch on hover.
